function.name: analyze_media
function.description: 【通用全模态内容理解·平台无关】让全模态大模型真正“看懂”任意图片/视频里到底有什么——不限平台（小红书/抖音/B站/视频号/微博/知乎/任意网站都行）。给它图片 URL/本地路径或视频 URL，它会解析画面、口播、画面里的文字、节奏与剪辑。视频走 Files API 整段上传理解（看完整段视频，而不是只看封面或标题）。典型用途：看懂一条视频到底讲了什么/怎么拍的、拆解爆款的视觉排版与文案、读懂图上的教程攻略文字、判断内容情绪。【强约束】凡是要对“视频/图片里到底有什么内容”下结论，都必须用本工具看过，严禁只凭标题/点赞数/评论臆测。

images.description: 需要分析的图片 URL 或本地绝对路径列表（任意平台，支持多图）。

video_url.description: 需要分析的视频 URL。可以是真实视频流 URL（mp4/m3u8/douyinvod 等），也可以是抖音等视频详情页 URL；工具会先尝试解析真实视频流/临时下载再交给 Files API 整段理解。超长/超大视频（超过 512MB 上限）会自动用 moviepy 压成审查代理（降分辨率/码率，不动原片，用完即删）再上传，长片单次推理会给足超时。若返回“未能解析真实视频流”，必须换方式获取真实流，不能把页面标题当视频内容。若结果开头带“【⚠️未完成·不可作为最终/通过结论】”，说明输出被长度截断、仅为半截，必须分镜/分段拆开重问后再下结论，不得直接采信。

title.description: 可选：内容标题，作为辅助上下文。

content.description: 可选：文字描述/正文，作为辅助上下文。

prompt.description: 发送给模型的分析指令。例如：'看完整段视频，告诉我这个博主是怎么拍的、讲了什么、节奏怎么安排的，总结可复用的拍法'。

function.name: code_run
function.description: Code executor. Prefer python. Multi-call OK, use script param. Reply code block is executed if no script arg; prefer for single call to avoid escaping. No hardcoding bulk data

script.description: [Mutually exclusive] NEVER use this param when use reply code block.

inline_eval.description: DO NOT USE except explicitly specified.

function.name: file_read
function.description: Read file. Read before modify for latest context and line numbers

keyword.description: [Optional] If provided, returns first match (case-insensitive) with context

function.name: file_patch
function.description: Replace unique old_content with new_content. Exact match required (whitespace/indentation). On failure, file_read to recheck

old_content.description: Original text block to replace (must be unique)

new_content.description: New content. Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}} to ref file lines, auto-expanded

function.name: file_write
function.description: Create/overwrite/append files. HUGE edits ONLY. Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}}, auto-expanded

function.name: update_working_checkpoint
function.description:
Short-term working notepad, auto-injected each turn to prevent info loss in long tasks. Call during early/mid stages, not at end. When: (1) after reading SOP, store user needs & key constraints (skip for simple 1-2 step tasks); (2) before subtask switch or context flush; (3) after repeated failures, re-read SOP and must store new findings; (4) on new task, update content, clear old progress but keep valid constraints.

Don't call: simple tasks (1-2 steps), task completed (use long-term memory tool)

key_info.description: Replaces current notepad (<200 tokens). Incremental update: review existing, keep valid, add/remove/modify. Store: pitfalls, user requirements, key params/findings, file paths, progress, next steps. Don't store: ephemeral info, obvious context, old task info when user switched tasks. Prefer over-updating over losing key info

related_sop.description: Related SOP names, tips for further re-read

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Interrupt task to ask user when needing decisions, extra info, or facing unresolvable blockers

candidates.description: Optional quick-select choices for the user

function.name: start_long_term_update
function.description: Start distilling long-term memory. Call when discovering info worth remembering (env facts/user prefs/lessons learned). Skip if memory already updated or in autonomous flow. Must call when a task that took 15+ turns is completed

function.name: web_scan
function.description: Get simplified HTML and tab list. Removes hidden/floating/covered elements. Call after switching pages

tabs_only.description: Show tab list only, no HTML

function.name: web_execute_js
function.description: Execute JS. Multi-call OK with different switch_tab_id. No guessing. Act accurately to reduce web_scan calls. Execute JS in ```javascript blocks if no script arg, prefer to avoid escaping

script.description: [Mutually exclusive] JS code or script path. NEVER use this param when use reply code block

no_monitor.description: Skip page change monitoring, saves 2-3s. Only for reads, not for page actions

switch_tab_id.description: [Optional] Tab ID to switch to before executing

function.name: xhs_task_init
function.description: Create a debug workspace tasks/<ts>_<slug>/ for this xhs session, copy the user image into it, return task_dir. Subsequent intermediate artifacts (dish_info.json, viral_refs/, edited images, annotated.png) should be saved here for the user to inspect later. Archival only, NOT a strict-flow gate.

user_request.description: Raw user request (used for naming the workspace)

image.description: [Optional] Local image path, auto-copied into workspace

function.name: xhs_identify_dish
function.description: Use Doubao VLM to identify the dish. Returns {dish_name, category, search_keywords, confidence}. Result auto-saved to task_dir/dish_info.json. Pass search_keywords[0] to xhs_search_viral.

function.name: xhs_search_viral
function.description:
Navigate to Xiaohongshu search page + scrape top N note covers → download to task_dir/viral_refs/ → return {reference_images: [local paths]} for xhs_image_review.
Xiaohongshu's default sort is good enough; this tool does navigate + scrape + download in a single call.
fetch_content (default 3): realClick top N cards into mask overlays to also grab body text + tags into viral_meta.json[covers[i].content] — required for caption writing.
Requires CDP-bridged Chrome with xiaohongshu.com logged in.

skip_navigate.description: true=don't navigate, scrape current page (when already on target page)

fetch_content.description: Scrape full body text + tags from top N notes (saved into viral_meta.json[covers[i].content]). Default 3 — required for caption writing. Pass 0 to explicitly skip

function.name: xhs_image_review
function.description: Xiaohongshu food cover strict-mode review (Doubao VLM). ⚠️ HARD REQUIREMENT: callers MUST first scrape viral covers from xiaohongshu/douyin and pass their local paths via reference_images — strict-mode scoring depends on viral comparison (viral_patterns/gaps_vs_viral/roast all rely on this). See skills/hard_skills/xhs_main/SKILL.md for full flow. Returns: score / verdict (PASS|REWORK|REPHOTO) / dimensions / viral_patterns / gaps_vs_viral / issues / edit_prompts / additional_shots_needed / roast / title_hints / summary

image.description: Local path or public URL of the image

hint.description: [Optional] Dish hint, e.g. 'Japanese ramen, main subject is noodles + chashu'

reference_images.description: STRONGLY RECOMMENDED 3-5 viral covers (paths/URLs). Without it only SOLO review runs — no viral_patterns/gaps_vs_viral/roast

function.name: xhs_image_edit
function.description: Doubao Seedream 4.5 i2i edit. Two uses: (A) beauty edits per review.edit_prompts; (B) DRAW ANNOTATIONS on the original — red arrows + Chinese labels teaching the user how to reshoot (e.g. 'red arrow above main dish labeling 加蒸汽'). Per skills/hard_skills/xhs_main/SKILL.md, ≥2 unsuccessful rounds MUST drop to REPHOTO and stop editing.

image.description: Local path or public URL of the original image

edit_prompts.description: Chinese prompts. Beauty: ['提亮整体 +15%','主菜表面增加自然油光']  Annotation: ['用红色箭头在主菜上方标注：加蒸汽','右下角标注：加葱花']

function.name: xhs_image_generate
function.description: Call Doubao Seedream 4.5 text-to-image to generate a brand-new image. Atomic capability. Used for: cover fallback / reference shots / composite scenes

prompt.description: Chinese t2i prompt, the more concrete the better

size.description: Size keyword '1K' / '2K' / '4K' or explicit dims like '2048x2048'

function.name: xhs_publish_note
function.description: Publish a set of images + caption as a Xiaohongshu note set to 「仅自己可见」(self-only) (creator center https://creator.xiaohongshu.com/publish/publish). NEW FLOW (2026-06, replaces draft-box/暂存 since phone & desktop drafts don't sync): upload → fill title/body/tags → CDP-pierce set visibility to 仅自己可见 → verify → then click 发布. HARD RULE: never clicks 发布 unless visibility is confirmed as self-only (anti mis-public). Prereqs: CDP bridge attached, creator center logged in, Chrome window focused in foreground (cdp_mouse_click needs focus). Flow: skills/hard_skills/xhs_publish/SKILL.md.

images.description: Local image paths (uploaded in order), 1-9. Usually task_dir/edited_*.png or viral_refs/ reuse

title.description: Note title (≤20 chars best, pick from review.title_hints)

desc.description: Note body (≥200 chars, finalized via review_sop §Step 4.5 template)

tags.description: 8-12 topic tags, with or without # (tool auto-prefixes). MUST be extracted from viral_meta.json[covers[*].content.tags] — no fabrication

function.name: web_visual_click
function.description: [The tool that ACTUALLY clicks — use it when you want to 'click'] Use this when hardcoded selectors fail (page redesigned / element not found). Mechanism is Set-of-Marks: enumerate every interactive element in the current viewport and overlay red numeric badges -> screenshot, let the VLM answer a multiple-choice 'which number to click' -> precisely scrollIntoView that element and click it (does NOT rely on VLM coordinates, avoiding mis-clicks). If the target is off-screen, it auto-scrolls up/down to find it. After clicking it captures a page fingerprint to verify a real change happened (verified field). Note: web_learn_page only builds an index and never clicks; the only tools that actually perform actions are this one (and web_visual_fill for typing). Prereq: CDP bridge attached. [Smart] On hit, the resolved selector is auto-cached (.cache/web_locator_cache.json); subsequent calls with same URL + target_desc go fast path. [Typical uses] (1) any site where selectors can't be grabbed (2) operating unfamiliar sites (3) when web_execute_js returns not_found (4) when the target is far down a long page and needs scrolling. Write target_desc with position + appearance + text so the VLM picks correctly.

target_desc.description: Natural-language description of the target element. Include relative position + visual features + visible text. e.g. 'the red "Publish" button at top-right of the page' / 'the title input box with placeholder "Enter title"' / 'the "Save draft" button in the lower-middle area'

function.name: web_visual_fill
function.description: [Generic fallback] Visually locate an input -> physical click to focus -> CDP insertText to type. Same scenario as web_visual_click, for input fields when selectors fail. [Smart] After the first VLM call, the resolved selector is auto-cached; subsequent calls with the same URL + target_desc go fast path and skip VLM. [Typical uses] (1) any site's form/rich-text editor where selectors can't be grabbed (2) unfamiliar sites (3) React/tiptap/ProseMirror inputs.

target_desc.description: Natural-language description of the target input (position + appearance + placeholder)

text.description: Text to insert (via CDP insertText, friendly to React/tiptap/ProseMirror)

function.name: web_learn_page
function.description: [Indexing only — NEVER performs actions] It merely identifies the current page's interactive elements and writes them to cache. It does NOT click, type, or trigger anything. To actually click/type you MUST then call web_visual_click / web_visual_fill — a successful learn_page only means 'noted where the elements are', not 'did it'. [When to use] Rarely — only when you anticipate operating many elements on the same page and want to pre-build the index to save later VLM cost; otherwise don't use it, just call web_visual_click directly (which also auto-learns into cache on first use). The VLM identifies the main interactive elements in one shot and caches them (.cache/web_locator_cache.json). Prereq: current tab is already on the target page.

url_hint.description: [Optional] hint about the current URL; can be omitted (will auto-read location.href)

function.name: xhs_check_login
function.description: Check Xiaohongshu login status by reading the page's window.__INITIAL_STATE__ user info (zero VLM, stable & fast). Returns {ok, logged_in, nickname, user_id}. Call this first before any read/interact flow to confirm the CDP-bridged Chrome is logged in.

function.name: xhs_list_feeds
function.description: Get the Xiaohongshu home recommendation feed (reads window.__INITIAL_STATE__.feed.feeds, zero VLM). Returns a simplified note list, each with id + xsec_token + xsec_source (all three are inputs for get_feed_detail / like_feed / favorite_feed / post_comment; pass xsec_source through verbatim to avoid token/source mismatch risk control). xsec_source here is 'pc_feed'. Use this to discover notes to interact with.

function.name: xhs_search_feeds
function.description: Search Xiaohongshu content by keyword (reads window.__INITIAL_STATE__.search.feeds, zero VLM). Returns a simplified note list, each with id + xsec_token + xsec_source for downstream tools. xsec_source here is 'pc_search' — you MUST pass it through to get_feed_detail/interact tools, otherwise the token/source mismatch triggers risk control (error_code 300031, '当前笔记暂时无法浏览'). Optional filters narrow results.

filters.description: [Optional] Search filters. Keys (all optional): sort_by(综合|最新|最多点赞|最多评论|最多收藏), note_type(不限|视频|图文), publish_time(不限|一天内|一周内|半年内), search_scope(不限|已看过|未看过|已关注), location(不限|同城|附近)

function.name: xhs_get_feed_detail
function.description: Get a note's full detail + comments (reads window.__INITIAL_STATE__.note.noteDetailMap, zero VLM). Requires feed_id + xsec_token obtained from list_feeds / search_feeds. When load_comments=true it scrolls to lazy-load comments. Also detects blocked/deleted/private notes.

xsec_source.description: [Optional but IMPORTANT] The token's origin page. Pass through the xsec_source returned alongside the token (search result → 'pc_search', home feed → 'pc_feed'). Mismatch triggers risk control. Defaults to 'pc_feed'.

function.name: xhs_user_profile
function.description: Get a user's profile info + note list (reads window.__INITIAL_STATE__.user, zero VLM). Requires user_id + xsec_token obtained from a note/search result.

xsec_source.description: [Optional] The token's origin page; pass through the xsec_source returned alongside the token. Defaults to 'pc_note'.

function.name: xhs_like_feed
function.description: Like / unlike a note (stable selector first, with state verification). Reads current liked state before acting; if already in the target state it skips (idempotent). Requires feed_id + xsec_token.

unlike.description: true = remove the like instead of adding it

xsec_source.description: [Optional] The token's origin page; pass through the xsec_source returned with the token (search → 'pc_search'). Defaults to 'pc_feed'.

function.name: xhs_favorite_feed
function.description: Favorite / unfavorite a note (stable selector first, with state verification). Reads current collected state before acting; if already in the target state it skips (idempotent). Requires feed_id + xsec_token.

unfavorite.description: true = remove the favorite instead of adding it

xsec_source.description: [Optional] The token's origin page; pass through the xsec_source returned with the token (search → 'pc_search'). Defaults to 'pc_feed'.

function.name: xhs_post_comment
function.description: Post a top-level comment on a note (stable selector first). Requires feed_id + xsec_token + content.

xsec_source.description: [Optional] The token's origin page; pass through the xsec_source returned with the token (search → 'pc_search'). Defaults to 'pc_feed'.

function.name: xhs_reply_comment
function.description: Reply to a specific comment under a note (stable selector first, scrolls to locate the comment). Requires feed_id + xsec_token + content, plus at least one of comment_id / user_id to locate the target comment.

user_id.description: [Optional] Target comment author user id ([data-user-id]); used when comment_id is unknown

xsec_source.description: [Optional] The token's origin page; pass through the xsec_source returned with the token (search → 'pc_search'). Defaults to 'pc_feed'.

function.name: create_skill
function.description: 当总结出有用的流程、prompt、经验时，创建一个新的技能SOP，存入技能库中。以后遇到类似场景即可读取该SOP。

skill_name.description: 技能名称，英文下划线命名，如 xhs_p_tu_prompt

sop_content.description: 技能的 Markdown 格式的 SOP 内容，包含规则、prompt模板、操作步骤等

function.name: update_user_preference
function.description: 记录或更新用户的习惯、偏好（如修图喜欢暗色调、文案喜欢活泼风格等），并保存到用户画像记忆中。
